Dream 2026-11-22 linked 15 vignettes from 7 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- undated · touches · "A good paradox axis is hard to find, and so we tend to generally use the classics" (Vignette: sized models, dreamtime as synthetic mapping)
- 2026-10-22 · touches · "we can judge a decision on the three axes. But each is independent." (Three independent axes; line 1 is where the energy goes (2026-10-22))
- 2026-10-23 · touches · "we will generally see a 2-1 yin/yang balance. An element will always have both." (Every element holds both poles, 2 to 1 (2026-10-23))
- 2026-10-23 · touches · "We use the 3 axes for domains as a default because it is directly tensions based." (Two synthetic systems, two maps (2026-10-23))
- 2026-10-23 · touches · "we can normally recognise yin and yang by how they appear in the domain" (Yin and yang show in how a pole appears in its domain (2026-10-23))
- 2026-10-23 · touches · "Our goal is to find 3 foundational ORTHOGONAL axes for a domain." (Three foundational orthogonal axes for a domain (2026-10-23))
- 2026-10-25 · retells · "get a definition of what a tradeoff is, and what it's properties are" (Define a trade-off and its properties, then test ours against it (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-25 · retells · "Each stage in this flow is it's own subdomain. Each will have its own tensions." (An archetypal flow as the ideal layer: each stage a subdomain with its own tensions (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-25 · touches · "an awareness of the tradeoffs so that we are tuning" (Four questions for any unit of work; we tune, we do not perfect (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-25 · touches · "Our whole boundary and tension practice is applied everywhere from the same rules" (The three lines and their poles are the creation myth: Wuji, Taiji, Yin/Yang, the eight images (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-27 · touches · "A domain defines the tensions, and a working group holds our strategy for approaching it." (Order is assessed against strategy: a domain defines the tensions, a working group holds the strategy (2026-10-27))
- 2026-10-27 · touches · "The three axis format allows us to assign strategic foundations with an archetype" (I have set strategy priority many times and we keep losing it; the three-axis format gives strategy an archetype (2026-10-27))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "I always start with them as my guide" (My thesis: the base lines are universal and the three axes can always be found (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "We have growing evidence (srs-programme) that these axes are generally valid." (Any domain inherits the base axes as working defaults (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-07 · touches · "Define boundary - divide yin and Yang - take only Yang as boundary... Repeat." (Simple domains lack clarity to be useful; cells are relative to a boundary, divide and repeat; dream boundaries are valid if we know where they came from; cluster may stay a name for a boundary with a function (2026-11-07))
